exit_criteria.text: Comment, Approve, Request changes, inline Publish and explicit immutable-plan tour publication do not open a CLI-specific modal; exact target, actor, disposition/content and one-use operation grants remain checked immediately at issuance and provider dispatch.

Runtime strict capability is required and every operation reacquires before dispatch; unsupported or failed acquisition refuses instead of restoring the old popup or creating a warning bypass. Trust/discovery/startup reuse issue zero writes.

Typed missing/unavailable/denied/tool/indeterminate outcomes reach existing review, comment and tour surfaces, preserve drafts and unknown-result reconciliation, and expose no raw process/Keychain details. Resolve stock-gh missing-vs-denied observability honestly before claiming the companion distinction.

First-use connection question and Accounts & hosts disclose chosen account/server, existing gh sign-in, remembered reuse, transient token and no BPR persistence. Residual executable/certificate/redirect/helper trust remains in the existing disclosure; stale tokenless/ambient-switch/socket claims are removed.
frontend-design is loaded before UX work; native palette/font/style/controls, keyboard focus and deduplicated status accessibility are preserved, with focused composed and Qt/offscreen evidence.
